output.objection: I am not asking for a passive audit trail on the drift signals. I need the compliance team to actively review and approve any automated response triggered by those signals.
output.correction: I did not mean to govern the monitoring process itself. I meant to govern the actions taken when drift is detected, especially where personal data is involved.
